reason: A DeepSeek Harness host plugin that injects missing browser polyfills into served pages to improve compatibility with older WebView and browser kernels, especially for mobile directory-picker and RPC flows.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 页面注入缺失的浏览器 Polyfill，以改善旧版 WebView 和浏览器内核中的目录选择器及 RPC 流程兼容性。
summaries.en: Injects missing browser polyfills into DeepSeek Harness pages to improve directory-picker and RPC compatibility on older WebView and browser kernels.

capabilities: Injects browser polyfills into served HTML pages through a webserver hook
Adds compatibility for AbortSignal.any and structuredClone when unavailable
